note: Pins for experimental/word_slots.py. Nothing here is a copy of the pinned files: the adapter reads each one at run time from a sibling checkout and refuses to run on a sha256 mismatch. Co-authored (JinnZ2 + Claude). CC0.

place_table.use: the place table (word -> ordered slots, senses). Table entries are PROPOSED in the source and stay PROPOSED here.

checker.use: imported, not copied: read_table and check_claim decide slot states, senses, verdicts and claim status.

predicate_reference.use: english word -> source predicate, for a claimed word the place table has no entry for (aggressive -> le'onmo). Used only to find the place-table entry built on the same predicate; slots still come from the place table. Its mappings are PROPOSED in the source and are carried as PROPOSED.

transport.use: optional. encode_record / decode_record only: the EB01 fixed-width record (16,460 bytes) the v1.1 COBOL copybook describes. The COBOL round trip itself (cobc) is not run from here, and the original generator (evidence/generate_copybook_as_received.py) is not used.
